Because absence from these inspected pages does not prove that Freshdesk has no MCP server elsewhere, the claim remains unresolved rather than being marked "no".

Because the schema requires one of self_serve_free, self_serve_trial, or self_serve_paid, the pricing tier cannot be classified from the available evidence and should remain unknown.
